newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel to ease closure of West Bank and Gaza.
newsitem.headline: Israel to ease closure of West Bank and Gaza.

text.p: Israel said on Saturday it would ease a protracted closure of the West Bank and Gaza Strip from Sunday morning.
"The easing will go into effect on Sunday at 4 a.m. (0200 GMT)," an Israel army spokeswoman said, adding: "Entry will be permitted to 35,000 workers who are married and over the age of 30."
She said 20,000 of the workers will be from the West Bank and the remainder from the Gaza Strip.
The spokeswoman said the Karni crossing between Israel and Gaza would open to imports and exports without restriction.
"In addition it was approved that merchandise could also be transferred from Gaza to Jordan."
Israel imposed a closure of the West Bank and Gaza Strip in February after a series of suicide bombings by Islamic militants killed 59 people in the Jewish state.
The closure, which bars Arab workers from reaching jobs in Israel, have suffocated an already struggling Palestinian economy.
